It does not change scope, commercials, technical claims, standards claims, approvals, exclusions, or change control. - **Authority:** Canonical product-taxonomy governance for the Puretronics Wire & Cable funnel and Product Master. - **Version:** 1.0 - **Effective date:** 30 July 2026 - **Taxonomy owner:** Vaibhav Kuvadia + Codex - **Operational steward:** Vaibhav Kuvadia + Codex - **Approval state:** Approved - **Canonical database:** - **Contractual authority:** # Canonical Product Families
ID Canonical Product Family Definition Product Master rows
PF-01 Inline Measurement & Dimensional Control Inline, non-contact dimensional measurement and the directly supporting measurement accessories used to monitor diameter, width, thickness, and ovality. 9
PF-02 Inline Spark Testing & Insulation Fault Detection Inline spark-test equipment and contextual fault-intelligence, marking, logging, and calibration support used to detect insulation faults during production. 7
PF-03 Cable Testing & Validation Offline electrical/HV validation and specialized fire-resistance or circuit-integrity testing systems. Fire testing is a subordinate solution theme, not a separate top-level family. 3
PF-04 Process Equipment & Line Auxiliaries Production equipment used for conductor joining, preheating, adhesion improvement, and static-powder application. 6
PF-05 Tension / Braking / Line Control Tension measurement and control, loadcells, braking systems, and their directly supporting integration items. 13
# Classification model - **Product Family** is the sole top-level stored product taxonomy. Every Product Master row has exactly one family. - **Solution Theme** is a subordinate many-to-many classification. It must not become a competing navigation hierarchy. - **Manufacturing Flow Stage** is an independent ordered production-stage axis. - **Primary Buyer Problem** is an independent buyer-discovery axis. - The buyer-facing funnel supports three parallel navigation modes: **Find by Problem**, **Find by Production Stage**, and **Find by Product Family**. - “Solution Block” is deprecated as an independent classification. Where a legacy data interface retains a `solution_block` field, its family-level values must align one-to-one with the canonical Product Family. - PF identifiers are governance identifiers. Buyer-facing content uses full technical family names. # Controlled Solution Theme vocabulary - Dimensional Measurement & Control - Spark Testing & Fault Intelligence - Electrical/HV Validation - Fire Resistance & Circuit Integrity - Wire Preheating & Adhesion - Static Powder Application - Conductor Joining & Repair - Tension Measurement & Control - Braking & Unwind/Rewind Control - Data & Reporting - Calibration & Support # Legacy-to-canonical crosswalk
Legacy value Canonical treatment
Online Measurement PF-01 Inline Measurement & Dimensional Control
Fault & Safety Testing — inline spark products and support items PF-02 Inline Spark Testing & Insulation Fault Detection
Fault & Safety Testing — AC HV, DC HV, and Fire Resistance Cable Testing PF-03 Cable Testing & Validation
Process Enhancement PF-04 Process Equipment & Line Auxiliaries
Tension / Braking / Automation PF-05 Tension / Braking / Line Control
HV & Cable Validation and Fire Resistance Cable Testing solution blocks Merge as PF-03, with Electrical/HV Validation and Fire Resistance & Circuit Integrity as distinct themes.
Line Stability, Adhesion & Tension Control solution block Split between PF-04 process equipment and PF-05 tension/braking/line control.
# Authoritative coverage - **PF-01 (9):** eight LASER models/variants plus Laser / Measurement Accessories Group. - **PF-02 (7):** Live Spark Tester, Acute Spark Tester, DC Spark Tester, three Spark Tester IoT support stages, and Spark Tester Sensitivity Calibrator. - **PF-03 (3):** AC HV Tester, DC HV Tester, and Fire Resistance Cable Testing System. - **PF-04 (6):** three Inline Induction Wire Preheater variants, LSP-G1, LSP-G2, and Butt Welding Machine. - **PF-05 (13):** WTI-90-40, WTI-100-40, LTC-PRO, six loadcell series, the loadcell amplifier/integration support row, and three AX pneumatic-brake variants. - **Total:** 38 rows; zero unmapped. # Support-item guardrail Support items remain contextual support items. They must not become standalone pages, campaigns, forms, automations, SEO assets, selectors, calculators, configurators, outreach tracks, or extra deliverables unless separately approved in writing. - Laser / Measurement Accessories Group remains contextual to PF-01. - Spark Tester IoT Stages 1–3 and the Sensitivity Calibrator remain contextual to PF-02. - Loadcell amplifier/accessory/integration items remain contextual to PF-05. - Product Master classification cannot override the Signed Agreement or create a commercial commitment. # Validation and change control - A taxonomy change requires a written governance decision, Product Master mapping update, downstream-content impact review, validator update, and a recorded version change. - Active content must not use deprecated families or old solution-block labels except inside this historical crosswalk. - The expected family-count invariant is **9 / 7 / 3 / 6 / 13**. - LTC-PRO must remain in PF-05. - Fire Resistance Cable Testing must use **Fire Resistance & Circuit Integrity**, not **Electrical/HV Validation**. - Standards and compliance statements remain subject to Puretronics technical validation. The BS EN 50200:2006 source reference remains `pending-puretronics-validation`; no external compliance claim may rely on it until Puretronics validates the applicable edition. # Change log - **1.0 — 30 July 2026:** Approved the five canonical Product Families, subordinate Solution Theme vocabulary, 38-row coverage invariant, support-item rules, ownership model, and legacy crosswalk. Signed Agreement unchanged. ## Approved Cross-System Label PF-05 uses **Tension / Braking / Line Control** in live Notion, repository data, routes, filters, tags, governance, and buyer-facing content. No punctuation variant or synonym is active. ## Migration Cutover The migration checkpoint was approved on 30 July 2026. The 38-row canonical mapping and `9 / 7 / 3 / 6 / 13` family invariant were revalidated. The temporary **Legacy Product Family** field was removed after the approved final checkpoint; rollback evidence remains in the repository migration exports and crosswalk. "}
